newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers flat to higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers flat to higher.

text.p: Basis offers in U.S. cash soybean meal markets were steady to slightly higher on Wednesday in quiet dealings, brokers said.
Basis levels continued to be bolstered by "good demand, good exports and a good crush," one cash source said.

On Tuesday, early sharp losses in CBOT futures spurred some pricing activity by commercial traders. However, the market's dramatic recovery in late trade "shut that off right away," one river broker said.
Supplies of nearby soymeal remained tight and brokers noted an increase in basis bids in cash soybean markets.
Most domestic end-users have booked their needs for November, and many are now on the sidelines considering purchases for December, a Minnesota-based broker said.
